messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"book_code":"2ES","chapter":12,"verses":[{"verse":41,"chapter":12,"text":"“How have we offended you? What evil have we done against you, that you have utterly forsaken us, and sit in this place?"},{"verse":42,"chapter":12,"text":"For of all the prophets, only you are left to us, like a cluster of the vintage, and like a lamp in a dark place, and like a harbor for a ship saved from the tempest."},{"verse":43,"chapter":12,"text":"Aren’t the evils which have come to us sufficient?"},{"verse":44,"chapter":12,"text":"If you will forsake us, how much better had it been for us if we also had been consumed in the burning of Zion!"},{"verse":45,"chapter":12,"text":"For we are not better than those who died there.” Then they wept with a loud voice. I answered them,"},{"verse":46,"chapter":12,"text":"“Take courage, O Israel! Don’t be sorrowful, you house of Jacob;"},{"verse":47,"chapter":12,"text":"for the Most High remembers you. The Mighty has not forgotten you forever."},{"verse":48,"chapter":12,"text":"As for me, I have not forsaken you. I haven’t departed from you; but I have come into this place to pray for the desolation of Zion, and that I might seek mercy for the humiliation of your sanctuary."},{"verse":49,"chapter":12,"text":"Now go your way, every man to his own house, and after these days I will come to you.”"},{"verse":50,"chapter":12,"text":"So the people went their way into the city, as I told them to do."},{"verse":51,"chapter":12,"text":"But I sat in the field seven days, as the angel commanded me. In those days, I ate only of the flowers of the field, and my food was from plants."}]}
